info.name: Purple Haze (Grey) for Mastodon [260207 UPDATED]
info.description: Made a slight background change to Purple Haze for Mastodon. Also changed the color of scroll bar to make it more readable. You may wanna use this theme if you prefer the grey background. *對 Purple Haze for Mastodon 原主題做了背景其他部分顔色變動，其餘部分沒有改變。 背景顔色的改變可以自己通過改動ui一欄中的background選項實現<3 Works with most of the Mastodon instances (with default theme). Feel free to use it in your own instance. (Don't forget to add the domain at the list) Suggestions for improvement are always appreciated.
